template_data.headline_html: Five reasons your teaming agreement goes nowhere.

items.title: Wrong prime, wrong NAICS
items.sub: Find primes actively winning in your code — not just any large business willing to sign.

items.title: Nothing specific to offer
items.sub: A clearance, a cert, a niche capability — primes need a concrete reason to include you.

items.title: Late to the conversation
items.sub: Teams form 6–12 months before an RFP. By solicitation day, the roster is already closed.

items.title: No capability statement ready
items.sub: If you can't explain your value in 60 seconds, the prime moves on before you finish.

items.title: No follow-up after the handshake
items.sub: Most sub relationships die because the sub goes quiet. Presence beats a perfect first pitch.
